summary.name: Ledge
summary.one_liner: Ledge is a free, open-source macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style status area for now playing, timers, meetings, weather, notes and Keep Awake.
keywords: keep mac awake with lid closed
use_cases: see what's playing from the notch
keep a Mac awake during long builds or agent runs
check the next meeting and join it with a camera preview
glance at weather and rain alerts
park files on the notch for later drag-out
replace the macOS volume and brightness pop-ups
summary.what_it_does: Ledge places a small status area around the MacBook notch that shows now-playing info for Music, Spotify and browser tabs, with skip and scrub controls. Hovering the notch opens a card with the day's calendar events and a month view. Its Keep Awake feature holds the Mac and screen awake, with an option to keep running with the lid closed via a small root helper. It also shows weather, timers, notes, a file shelf, battery, AirPods status, Focus changes, and camera/microphone indicators, and replaces the volume and brightness pop-ups. Each feature can be turned off individually.
notable: Open source under GPL-3.0 with no account and no telemetry
Keep Awake with optional lid-closed mode using a root helper installed only while active
Weather from Open-Meteo with location rounded to about 1 km; otherwise limited network use
Hidden from screenshots and screen sharing by default
caveats: Requires a MacBook with a notch and macOS 26 or later; no support for macOS 15 or earlier
Only draws on the built-in display; external monitors and Macs without a notch get nothing
Lid-closed Keep Awake needs a small root helper, and Ledge quitting lets the Mac sleep again
